MikroTik 2.5in SATA 32GB SSD UEFI x86 RouterOS 64bit License Level 6

The MikroTik 2.5in SATA 32GB SSD UEFI x86 RouterOS 64bit License (Pre-Install) Level 6 is a high-performance storage solution designed for MikroTik routers and servers. With 32GB of storage, this SSD provides sufficient space to handle operating system files, configuration data, software updates, and network logs, ensuring smooth operation in both small and medium-sized network environments. Built with UEFI boot mode, this SSD ensures faster boot times and compatibility with modern MikroTik devices, offering better performance and quicker system startup compared to traditional BIOS. It is engineered for use with PC MikroTik machines and supported MikroTik server machines, allowing easy integration into a variety of setups. The SSD comes pre-installed with RouterOS version v7.11, MikroTik's powerful network operating system that provides robust features for network management, security, routing, and more. In addition, the device supports OS version updates and downgrades, giving users the flexibility to keep their system up to date with the latest features or revert to earlier versions as needed. Included with the SSD is the MikroTik Level 6 license, unlocking advanced RouterOS features such as dynamic routing, VPN support, firewall management, and more. The Level 6 license is ideal for users who need more powerful and customizable network capabilities, providing extensive control over network performance and security. The MikroTik 2.5in SATA 32GB SSD also comes with technical support and warranty coverage, ensuring peace of mind for users with access to assistance and protection against any potential defects. Available in multiple capacities — 16GB, 32GB, 64GB, and 128GB — this SSD offers scalable options to suit a wide range of networking needs. The MikroTik 2.5in SATA 32GB SSD provides reliable, cost-effective storage for MikroTik-powered routers and servers, delivering excellent performance, flexibility, and value for network professionals.
